claims.label: Host Says TPUSA UVU Chapter Declined On-Site Ambulance
claims.claim: The host says, citing an ABC News report, that TPUSA's UVU chapter declined an on-site ambulance by marking "No" on the EMS section of the school's online event form.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain UVU event form records directly; cross-check against TPUSA's later framing in the wrongful-death filing.

claims.label: Per ABC News Report, UVU Attendance Estimate Progressed 200 to 600 to 1,500 to About 3,000
claims.claim: Per the ABC News report the host reads, the UVU event attendance was initially estimated at 200, revised to 600, then, per TPUSA, to 1,500 (in a later conversation the host says was undocumented), with actual attendance of about 3,000.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain UVU planning documents directly; verify timing of each revision; identify whether any "1,500" update exists in any retained form.

claims.label: TPUSA Statement to ABC News Framed UVU Event as Open-to-Public / Unticketed Prove Me Wrong Format
claims.claim: Per a Turning Point USA official's statement to ABC News that the host reads, the UVU event was styled as open-to-public and unticketed, comparable to prior "Prove Me Wrong" campus events; the host adds that such events have no crowd control.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify whether the same open-event rationale was applied to security/staffing decisions; compare to documented Prove Me Wrong events.

claims.label: 2019 Text Thread Forwarded "Operation Greyer X anonymous" Plan
claims.claim: A November 12–13, 2019 text thread shows Andrew Kolvet forwarding to Candace Owens a message attributed to "E" describing a plan to seed a public feud between Charlie Kirk and Candace Owens ("Operation Greyer X anonymous").
claims.investigative_direction: Authenticate the text screenshot metadata; verify whether "E" was in fact Erika Frantzve at that time; cross-check against Kolvet's recent public statements on the same feud narrative.

claims.label: 4plebs Post Mirrors The Forwarded "Operation" Plan
claims.claim: Per the 4plebs post the host shows, which Andrew Kolvet said Erika ("E") found and said was linked in a Vox article (the host says the article does not link to the post), the post set out the same Charlie/Candace feud-seeding narrative – ask "gripers" to put Charlie against Candace; "fluff" Candace's ego; frame Candace as driven out of TPUSA by Kirk fearing her.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the 4plebs post URL and archived timestamp; verify content alignment; verify whether the Vox article actually linked to this post or only to the broader 4plebs forum.

claims.label: Clip Has Charlie Kirk Describing Club America as Opt-In / Grassroots / Debate-Club Parallel
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays of his presentation to Aspen donors, Charlie Kirk says the high school program is now called Club America, that 80 new full-time staff were hired to source high school students who want to start chapters and guide them through the process, and that he wants Club America to be built in like DECA or the debate club; the host calls this a grassroots vision.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full audio/presentation recording; verify against any written strategic plans; cross-check against current TPUSA Club America implementation.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Kirk Spoke at Nampa Christian School Assembly Where Students Were Not Opt-In Participants
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk spoke at a Nampa Christian School assembly where students were not voluntary opt-in participants, citing parent emails she received and a student's text messages to a parent that she shows describing students unable to leave and "locked in the gym."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the school newsletter referenced by parents; verify assembly mandatory-attendance status; verify whether parental attendance was actually prohibited.

claims.label: TPUSA Claimed 500+ Nampa Christian School Attendees
claims.claim: TPUSA's X post claimed 500+ "outstanding high school student attendees" at the Nampa Christian School event as part of the Club America tour.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check TPUSA claim against school attendance records and parent reports.

claims.label: Per Kolvet's X Reply, Three Students Opted Out of Nampa Assembly
claims.claim: Per Andrew Kolvet's reply on X that the host shows, three students opted out of the Nampa assembly and "over 500 chose to attend"; the host characterizes this as a technicality, saying Kolvet is implying nothing was forced.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify whether the cited "opt-out" mechanism applies to mandatory school assemblies; obtain school policy on opt-outs from assemblies.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet Cited Security Reasons For Not Marketing Event Publicly
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet replied on X that TPUSA does not market the events publicly for "security reasons" and thanked Candace for "all your help on that."
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check against TPUSA's prior statements on event security; verify whether a no-marketing policy applied to Nampa specifically or to all Club America high school stops.

claims.label: Politico Published Profile Of Blake Neff
claims.claim: Per a Politico profile of Blake Neff by Ian Ward that the host shows, the article's subtitle is "Blake Neff helped make stars of Charlie Kirk and Tucker Carlson. He's now trying to rein in what he unleashed." and its headline is "Charlie Kirk's lieutenant has second thoughts."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full Politico article and publication date.

claims.label: Politico Profile Framed Blake Neff's Free Speech Position As "Maximalist"
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Tucker Carlson says the Politico profile (author Ian Ward) framed Blake Neff's position as a "maximalist position on free speech" and notes this is the author's framing, not a Neff quote.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify direct attribution of the "maximalist" phrase to Ward vs Neff.

claims.label: Clip Has Tucker Carlson Criticizing Blake Neff's "Make Our Peace With Censorship" Framing
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Tucker Carlson criticizes Blake Neff's framing that "we may have to make our peace with censorship," reading from and rejecting the premise of the Politico profile.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the original Tucker Carlson platform/episode where this criticism aired; verify whether Carlson explicitly named Neff.

claims.label: Blake Neff Verbatim Censorship Quote
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Tucker Carlson reads what he calls a verbatim quote from Blake Neff: "Either we have to make our peace with censorship and explain how we're going to do that or we have to explain how we're going to combat this without censorship. Period. But we've got to confront it."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm full quote and attribution context in Politico article.

claims.label: Host Says Empress Films Was Founded by Emma Cooper in 2020
claims.claim: The host says Empress Films is a documentary company founded by Emma Cooper in 2020, and that Cooper was previously global president of non-scripted television at Pulse Films and worked on the Netflix documentary "The Disappearance of Madeleine McCann."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify corporate filings and Pulse Films tenure via public records.

claims.label: Host Says Empress Films' Production Focus Includes True Crime / Murder Mystery Content
claims.claim: The host says Empress Films' production catalog includes true crime / murder mystery documentaries: Ghislaine Maxwell (2021), Marilyn Monroe, Jill Dando, Princess Diana, Depp vs Heard, and Gilgo Beach murders.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify each production's distribution platform, release date, and reception.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Kirk and Andrew Kolvet Had an August 28, 2025 Call with Empress Films Executives
claims.claim: The host says she learned that on August 28, 2025, Erika Kirk and Andrew Kolvet participated in a call with Empress Films executives, including executive producer Eben Davidson (LA office; ex-Paramount) and founder Emma Cooper, plus two unnamed producers.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify and obtain direct confirmation from call participants or schedules; cross-check Empress Films project pipeline for Aug–Sep 2025.

claims.label: Candace Concurs With @spilling the TPUSA/UVU Anniversary Observation
claims.claim: Candace concurs with the @spilling the tea observation that holding a Charlie Kirk one-year anniversary event at UVU is inconsistent with TPUSA's UVU-negligence claims.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify whether TPUSA scheduled an anniversary event at UVU; identify the venue.

claims.label: Candace Concurs With @Koko Rose Tyler Robinson Footage Observation

claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Utah news reporting on precinct footage handling; verify the Brian Cole Jr. footage attribution.

claims.claim: While promoting merchandise, the host says the "CIA" hats should actually say "decentralized intelligence agency" because "we got nothing to hide."
claims.investigative_direction: Preserve as brand / network framing claim; cross-link M-12 meme occurrence when present.
claims.transcript_snippet: ...you can buy a CIA hats. It actually should be the decentralized intelligence agency. We got nothing to hide. I love the conspiracy girly muggy. That's actually kind of my favorite mug...

claims.label: Host Says the Event Drew 3,000 Despite Being Barely Advertised

claims.investigative_direction: Review TPUSA and UVU promotion records for the September 10 event, including social posts and flyers.
claims.transcript_snippet: 3,000 people show up for this event, which was barely advertised.
